omarchy.polkit|service|enable|Core graphical authorization agent.
omarchy.power|bar-widget|enable|Core battery and power-profile panel.
omarchy.reminders|overlay|disable|Optional reminder workflow is outside the first runnable shell.
omarchy.spacer|bar-widget|disable|Not used by the fixed first-run bar layout.
omarchy.speedtest|panel|disable|Optional network benchmark is outside the first runnable shell.
omarchy.system-update|bar-widget|disable|Upstream updater must never own ARM kernel or boot updates.
omarchy.tailscale|bar-widget|disable|Optional third-party network service is not in the ARM core.
omarchy.tray|bar-widget|enable|Core StatusNotifier tray integration.
